question: What are the essential elements of a valid contract under the Indian Contract Act, 1872?

points.label: Offer and acceptance
points.description: There must be a lawful offer and a lawful acceptance of it, resulting in an agreement.

points.label: Intention and consideration
points.description: The parties must intend to create legal relations, and there must be lawful consideration.

points.label: Capacity of parties
points.description: The parties must be competent to contract: of the age of majority, of sound mind and not disqualified by law.

points.label: Free consent
points.description: Consent must be free, i.e. not caused by coercion, undue influence, fraud, misrepresentation or mistake.

points.label: Lawful object and other essentials
points.description: The object must be lawful, the agreement must not be expressly declared void, and its meaning must be certain and its performance possible; any required legal formalities must be met.
